name: geo-real-estate-platform
description: 地理空间房地产中介服务平台

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && nohup npm run dev > ../backend.log 2>&1 & echo $! > ../backend.pid
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && nohup npm run dev > ../frontend.log 2>&1 & echo $! > ../frontend.pid
scripts.start:all: npm run start:backend && sleep 3 && npm run start:frontend
scripts.stop:backend: pid=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:59056 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | head -n1); cwd=$(ps -o cwd= -p "$pid" | xargs 2>/dev/null); cmd=$(ps -o command= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null); case "$cwd" in "$(pwd)"/*) kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null && rm -f backend.pid && echo "Backend stopped" ;; *) echo "skip kill: cwd=$cwd cmd=$cmd" ;; esac
scripts.stop:frontend: pid=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:49056 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | head -n1); cwd=$(ps -o cwd= -p "$pid" | xargs 2>/dev/null); cmd=$(ps -o command= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null); case "$cwd" in "$(pwd)"/*) kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null && rm -f frontend.pid && echo "Frontend stopped" ;; *) echo "skip kill: cwd=$cwd cmd=$cmd" ;; esac
scripts.stop:all: npm run stop:frontend; npm run stop:backend
scripts.status: PROJECT_DIR="$(pwd)"; FRONTEND_PORT=49056; BACKEND_PORT=59056; frontend_pid=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:$FRONTEND_PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t | head -n1); backend_pid=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:$BACKEND_PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t | head -n1); echo "Frontend PID: $frontend_pid"; echo "Backend PID: $backend_pid"; [ -n "$frontend_pid" ] && ps -p "$frontend_pid" -o pid=,ppid=,stat=,cwd=,command= 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$backend_pid" ] && ps -p "$backend_pid" -o pid=,ppid=,stat=,cwd=,command= 2>/dev/null; curl -I --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$FRONTEND_PORT/ 2>/dev/null | head -n1; curl -sS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$BACKEND_PORT/api/health 2>/dev/null
